results.title: GeoPackage schema compatibility
results.summary: Turso mutates a standards-compliant WorldCRS84Quad GeoPackage and leaves it readable by SQLite and GDAL.

checks.name: Turso opens a conformant GeoPackage
checks.detail: the file created by ordinary SQLite opened without complaint

checks.name: put, upsert and delete work with constraints enabled
checks.detail: insert, ON CONFLICT upsert and delete all succeeded against the conformant schema

checks.name: unique tile coordinate constraint is enforced
checks.detail: a duplicate coordinate was rejected: Error: step failed: Runtime error: UNIQUE constraint failed: tiles.(zoom_level, tile_column, tile_row) (19)

checks.name: schema survives the round trip unchanged
checks.detail: every table, index and constraint is byte for byte what ordinary SQLite declared

checks.name: ordinary SQLite reopens the file cleanly
checks.detail: integrity_check returned ok with no foreign key violations

checks.name: GeoPackage identity is preserved
checks.detail: application_id and user_version are still 1196444487 / 10300

checks.name: mutations produced the expected rows
checks.detail: the upserted tile remains and the deleted tile is gone

checks.name: GDAL reopens the file
checks.detail: GDAL opened it as a 4096x2048 WGS 84 raster

results.title: Cross-process concurrent writes
results.summary: Independent processes write the shared file correctly and faster than serialized SQLite.

checks.name: every writer process ran to completion
checks.detail: all writers in all 18 scenarios started and reported

checks.name: no acknowledged mutation disappears
checks.detail: every batch a writer was told had committed is present in the commit log after reopen

checks.name: latest successful commit wins at every coordinate
checks.detail: the stored bytes at every coordinate match the last commit for it in commit order

checks.name: the shared file stays valid
checks.detail: ordinary SQLite reports integrity_check ok after every scenario

checks.name: conflicts are retryable rather than fatal
checks.detail: bounded jittered backoff absorbed all contention; no batch exhausted its retries

checks.name: throughput beats a serialized SQLite writer
checks.detail: inconclusive on this host: 2 of 3 writer counts had repetitions on both sides of parity (2 writers: median 0.92x, range 0.92-1.14x; 4 writers: median 0.86x, range 0.59-1.01x; 8 writers: median 0.64x, range 0.29-0.86x). Re-run on a quiet machine before drawing a conclusion.

measurements.note: Local filesystem only. The OpenShift RWX StorageClass has not been exercised; see gate 4 notes in the README.
